tutorial: Arch_tutorial.md (Arch tutorial). The tutorial builds a real house from a DWG and gives no plan that can be typed in, so this model is a small house built with the tutorial's own stated sizes: exterior walls 25 cm, interior walls 15 cm, the main door 1 m x 2.45 m, interior doors 0.70 m x 2.10 m, a 15 cm floor slab, a 2.25 m column, lower walls stopping at 2.60 m. Roof usage follows Arch_Roof.md (counter-clockwise outline, 90 degrees for a gable).

notCovered: bim_reference: needs a second saved .FCStd on the Mac (save this document, then bim_reference { path } in a new one)
bim_image_plane: needs an image file on the Mac (tests/test_bim_gaps.py covers it)
bim_library: needs the parts_library add-on or a folder of parts (tests/test_bim_gaps.py covers it with a temporary folder)
bim_nest: needs flat single-face pieces and a sheet face (tests/test_bim_gaps.py test_10_nest covers it; draft_shape rectangles with a face would do live)
bim_remove_shape, bim_reextrude, bim_rewire, bim_glue: tidy-up commands with no place in the house (tests/test_bim_gaps.py covers them)
bim_edit add / subtract / join: test_11_join covers join; subtracting the Roof from the walls is worth one live try (bim_edit { op: "subtract", object: "Outer walls", with: ["Roof"] })
ifc_save overwrite: true, and bim_import's fallback reader
code_* tools: an add-on's, not this repository's
